name: PFC Jones
summary: A Jones appears three times in Larry's 2026-08-15 identifications: he believes the crewman working at the rotor head in VN-0012 is PFC Jones; he names the white-T-shirted man climbing into the Huey in VN-0020 as PFC Jones; and Sarge the monkey (VN-0017) may have belonged to "Jones, the helicopter pilot." Whether the PFC crewman and "the helicopter pilot" are one man loosely described or two different Joneses is unresolved.
researchNotes: An enlisted crew chief would fit both the rotor-head maintenance work (VN-0012) and climbing into the Huey (VN-0020); crew chiefs flew, which could explain a loose 'helicopter pilot' description. Jones is too common for a blind roster search — needs the unit settled first, or a first name from Larry. Ask whether there was one Jones or two.
